result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 (Government), covering city contract protests, contract alterations, prevailing wage compliance, electronic transactions and public works contract award rules, none of which concern residential rental rules.
result.notes: The source URL and metadata suggest the page concerns San Diego's ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices (Division 11, section 98.1103), but this part of the document contains only San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 2 sections 22.3017 to 22.3109 on municipal procurement and public works contracting. No text in this part states a rule in any of the six residential rental categories, so no records were extracted.
